lines.t: Beloved
All is forgiven you
Your sins past, present, yes Even those of tomorrow
For I know Your heart And the love which You have for me
Therefore make Your love perfect by obedience
and no longer let your flesh rule over you or prevent you by any means it is the penitent man
who shall know God and penitent you must be died to yourselves daily cast off the skin of this
And walk with me as I am
And not as you would have me be
And all that you require shall be given you
Says the Lord
And again
For only those who come to me
And drink shall be made new
Whether awake or sleeping
All my beloved shall arise
And live for I am he
The resurrection and the life
My son I died for the forgiveness of your sins
Those of today, yesterday
today and those sins of tomorrow yet man does continually stumble over his flesh
being tempted in a world filled with sin and so he must continually come to me
and even 70 times seven times shall i cleanse him and lift him up
And again, for this my son or daughter
Is true repentance, says the Lord
Conviction brings about revelation
In those in whom my spirit dwells
And when it is finished
Does it not also lead to repentance
Producing new and righteous works
A deep desire
To be set free in my love
Followed by a sincere unyielding commitment
To make your love perfect through obedience
says the Lord
